name: Desiccant Adsorption Dehumidifier
subtitle: Drying-rotor humidity control for process and storage rooms
bullets: Moisture removed by a desiccant rotor
For rooms that need a low humidity
Suited to storage and process areas
Selected to the room and the duty
overview: A desiccant adsorption dehumidifier dries air with a rotor rather than relying on a cooling coil alone. That suits archives, stores, process rooms and other spaces that have to hold a low humidity. Cosmix Engineering supplies, installs and supports the unit for the room and the moisture load.

features.title: Adsorption drying
features.text: Process air passes over a drying rotor, so humidity can be held down even when cooling is not the main requirement.

features.title: Process and storage
features.text: Typical rooms are stores, archives and process areas where damp air would affect the goods or the work.

features.title: Sized for the room
features.text: Air volume and the humidity to be held decide the model. Share those with Cosmix and we will recommend a unit.

lineupNote: Tell us the room volume and the humidity you need to hold. We will match a model.
ctaText: Share the room, the humidity you need to hold, and the city. Cosmix will recommend a unit.

name: Inverter Dehumidifier
subtitle: Refrigerant dehumidifier with inverter control
bullets: For rooms and smaller commercial spaces
overview: An inverter dehumidifier removes moisture with a refrigerant circuit and a variable-speed compressor. It suits rooms and smaller commercial spaces where humidity, rather than a full air-conditioning plant, is the task. Cosmix Engineering supplies and installs the unit to the size of the space.

features.title: Inverter control
features.text: The compressor modulates instead of simply switching on and off, which keeps removal steady as the room load changes.

features.title: Rooms and commercial spaces
features.text: A practical choice for offices, stores and other rooms that need drier air without a central plant.

features.title: Sized for the room
features.text: Floor area and how dry the room needs to be decide the model. Cosmix will recommend one from those details.

lineupNote: Tell us the space and how dry it needs to be. We will match a model.
ctaText: Share the space and the humidity you need. Cosmix will recommend a unit.
